scope: National gun-taking case-table government coding excluding Delhi, allocated to another reviewer. 15 event mappings; no root case CSV edited.
coding_rule: Join political administration to manually coded incident date, not publication date or a politician’s current/later party. Spell dates are source conventions, not uniformly inclusive legal timestamps; none of these incidents falls on a disputed boundary. Null end means not required/fully audited for this task, not an assertion of current incumbency. Party-at-incident values apply to mapped cases and must not be expanded uncritically over later rename dates.
causal_caution: Government co-occurrence is descriptive. It does not establish orders, knowledge, responsibility for an individual shooting, or comparative party incidence.
